instant_rejection_email.subject: Update on your PotionLabs AI & Coding Intern application
instant_rejection_email.body:
Hi {name},

Thank you for applying for the AI & Coding Intern role at PotionLabs.

We believe in complete transparency and respect your time. Rather than making you wait weeks in an uncertain queue, our system performs an immediate baseline assessment.

At this time, your profile did not meet our baseline requirements ({reason}). For this role, we require hands-on experience with production-level Python, background worker patterns, and AI agents that execute real actions and tool calls (rather than conversational chatbot interfaces).

We encourage you to explore tool-calling patterns and real backend systems, and we welcome your application in future hiring cycles.

Best regards,
PotionLabs Hiring Team
